title: Naturality of global-section transport through inverse-image composition
statement: Let $X,Y,L,K$ be schemes, with morphisms $a:L\to Y$, $c:K\to Y$, $b:Y\to X$, and $m:K\to L$ satisfying $m a=c$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $G$ be an abelian etale sheaf on $X$, $H$ one on $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $i:b^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}H$ an isomorphism. Let $t_a:\Gamma(L,(ba)^{-1}G)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(L,a^{-1}H)$ be global sections applied to the inverse-image composition isomorphism $(ba)^{-1}G\to a^{-1}b^{-1}G$ followed by $a^{-1}i$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]; define $t_c$ in the same way. Write $P_G$ for pullback along $m$ on global sections [def-weil-pbc-finite-section-pullback], followed by the comparison $m^{-1}(ba)^{-1}G\to(bc)^{-1}G$ using $ma=c$, and write $P_H$ for pullback followed by $m^{-1}a^{-1}H\to c^{-1}H$. Then $t_c(P_G s)=P_H(t_a s)$ for every $s\in\Gamma(L,(ba)^{-1}G)$. There is no etaleness or finiteness hypothesis on the morphisms.

proof.text: Expand globalSectionsUpperStarMap into the unit evaluated at the terminal object and the terminal base-change map. The naturality equations for the two global-section/evaluation isomorphisms, the unit, and the sheaf map at the terminal base-change arrow prove its naturality in the sheaf morphism. This is the proved private helper globalSectionsUpperStarMap_natural.

Substitute c=ma. Apply the proved upstream upperStarComp_assoc to m,a,b and evaluate at G. Cancel its invertible forward comparison to obtain the equality of the two inverse comparison composites. Combine this with naturality of upperStarComp.inv at i and the naturality of globalSectionsUpperStarMap from the first step. Apply the global-sections functor and evaluate on s. This is a complete Lean proof, with no new open coherence assumption.

theorem pullbackSectionTransportEquiv_naturality
    {X Y L K : Scheme.{u}} (a : L ⟶ Y) (c : K ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ X)
    (m : K ⟶ L) (hm : m ≫ a = c)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (H : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (i : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} b).obj G ≅ H)
    (s : (Sheaf.Γ L.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (a ≫ b)).obj G)) :
    let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    pullbackSectionTransportEquiv c b G H i
      ((globalSectionsUpperStarMap A m ((upperStar A (a ≫ b)).obj G) ≫
        (Sheaf.Γ K.smallEtaleTopology A).map
          ((upperStarComp A m (a ≫ b) (c ≫ b)
            (by rw [← Category.assoc, hm])).inv.app G)) s) =
    (globalSectionsUpperStarMap A m ((upperStar A a).obj H) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ K.smallEtaleTopology A).map
        ((upperStarComp A m a c hm.symm).inv.app H))
          (pullbackSectionTransportEquiv a b G H i s)
